Salesforce
Salesforce is a leading cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) platform used by businesses of all sizes and industries worldwide.
At its core, Salesforce is a powerful suite of software tools and applications designed to help organizations effectively manage their interactions with customers, streamline sales processes, and drive business growth.
Organize, share, search, and manage content within your organization and across key areas of Salesforce with Salesforce CRM Content.
Content includes all file types, from traditional business documents such as Microsoft® PowerPoint presentations to audio files, video files, Web pages, and Google docs.

Azure
Cloud computing platform developed by Microsoft.
Offers a broad range of services: computing, analytics, storage, networking, and more.
Enables businesses to build, deploy, and manage applications through Microsoft-managed data centers.
Supports various operating systems, languages, frameworks, databases, and devices.
Scalable and secure infrastructure for hybrid, public, and private cloud solutions.
Integrated tools for identity management, security, compliance, and DevOps.
Helps teams organize, share, and manage cloud resources efficiently.
Ideal for digital transformation, AI development, and enterprise-grade solutions.
AWS
The most comprehensive and widely adopted cloud platform globally.
Offers 200+ fully featured services including compute, storage, database, analytics, and more.
Supports a vast range of use cases: web/mobile apps, enterprise software, AI/ML, IoT, etc.
Scalable, secure, and pay-as-you-go infrastructure.
Popular services include EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and DynamoDB.
Facilitates data organization, storage, and high-performance processing.
Trusted by startups, large enterprises, and government organizations worldwide.
Offers global availability, reliability, and a robust security model.
GCP
Cloud platform developed by Google with IaaS, PaaS, and serverless offerings.
Known for high performance, scalability, and strong data security.
Enables fast development and deployment using Google’s global infrastructure.
Offers powerful tools for big data, machine learning, and multi-cloud operations.
Supports a wide variety of workloads and developer tools.
Helps organizations collaborate and manage digital assets seamlessly.
Strong support for AI/ML, analytics, and cloud-native application development.
Ideal for innovation-driven enterprises and scalable cloud solutions.
